lead: We’re building AgroGina to help large agricultural operations in Morocco connect daily work, business records and evidence from the field. Local farming realities are our starting point.

workflow.title: From the field to the decision
workflow.description: Our direction: connect what teams observe and measure with the work they manage.
workflow.caveat: AgroGina already has farm clients and is being validated with farms. This diagram shows our direction; it does not claim that every IoT or ground-observation integration is available today.
workflow.imageAlt: Conceptual editorial illustration of a hand inspecting soil, a soil sensor, farm records and cultivated parcels. It is not a photograph of a deployed farm installation.

why.title: Local realities. Broader ambition.
why.text: We saw a gap in tools that understand Moroccan agricultural operations while providing a path toward international standards and useful AI integrations. We want to build that path with farms, not assume we already know every answer.

evidence.title: Three sources. Different strengths.
evidence.intro: Some teams trust what they can see and measure on their land. Others need data provenance and integrity. A useful system must respect both.

cards.title: On the ground
cards.value: Field visits, samples and observations provide concrete context for understanding what is happening.
cards.limit: Record when, where and how the observation was made.

cards.title: IoT measurements
cards.value: Sensors can add measurements between visits and connect equipment readings with operational records.
cards.limit: Calibration, placement, maintenance and missing readings matter.

cards.title: Satellite analysis
cards.value: Imagery can help reveal patterns across larger areas and guide questions for teams in the field.
cards.limit: Check the date, resolution and local context. A remote estimate is not a ground measurement.

evidence.takeaway: Make the origin, age and limits of information as visible as the insight itself.

is: Farms and parcels, field tasks and workforce.
Inputs, stock, purchasing, sales, costs and accounting.
A direction that brings operational records and field evidence together.
scope.notTitle: A tool that supports human judgment
not: No replacement for farmers or agronomists.
No claim that every device integration is ready, or that AI and satellite estimates are always correct.
No automatic guarantee of compliance or certification.

roadmap.title: Where we are—and what comes next

stages.label: Today
stages.title: Working with farm clients
stages.text: AgroGina already has farm clients. We are validating workflows with farms and improving the platform around their day-to-day needs.

stages.label: Next
stages.title: Improve from field feedback
stages.text: Strengthen connected workflows, resolve friction observed with farms, and define useful ground-observation and IoT integrations.

stages.label: Longer term
stages.title: Connect trusted evidence
stages.text: Improve provenance, quality checks and reporting, then introduce AI where its practical value can be demonstrated.

roadmap.caveat: Farm-client use and validation are already under way. Future integrations remain priorities, not delivery dates or standards-certification claims.
